title: Umbraflow RuntimeArtifact manifest
description: Exact RFC 8785 JCS manifest bytes for one immutable runtime artifact. The Host confines paths before access, verifies every size and SHA-256, requires assets to be sorted and unique by UTF-8 path, and requires the asset set to exactly equal the trusted parser output.

runtime_artifact_format.$comment: The generation of this manifest contract a Host must understand, not the bytes of the file that states it. Editing this schema's prose is not a new generation and must not refuse an artifact already published against it.

runtime_model_format.$comment: The generation of umbraflow-runtime-v3.schema.json the trusted parser must understand to read runtime-model.toml. modules/task/runtime/model.luau states the same number as model.format, and the Host refuses an artifact whose parser answers with a different one.
